description: Agent-based diffusion of innovation model on a social network with marketing adstock, opinion dynamics, and time-bound policy incentives, producing daily adoption observables for calibration and prediction.

modules.name: SocialNetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs the social network with configurable degree, rewiring, and homophily/assortativity across segments.

update_rule.pseudocode:
on_initialize:
  set_rng(global.random_seed)
  N = len(population.Persons)
  # derive per-node target degrees with heterogeneity
  degrees = sample_lognormal_mean(network.avg_degree, network.degree_heterogeneity, N)
  # create base small-world graph
  G = watts_strogatz_like(N, round(mean(degrees)), network.rewiring_prob)
  # increase/modify edges for homophily by segment
  for each edge (i,j) in G:
    if segment(i) != segment(j) and rand() < network.homophily_strength:
      attempt_rewire_to_same_segment(i or j)
  # apply segment assortativity constraint via MCMC edge swaps
  while measured_assortativity(G, segment) < network.segment_assortativity and budget_not_exceeded:
    perform_segment_preserving_edge_swap_increasing_assortativity(G)
  # triadic closure
  for each node i:
    for each pair (u,v) among neighbors(i):
      if not edge(u,v) and rand() < network.triadic_closure_prob:
        add_edge(u,v)
  assign_neighbors_and_degree(G -> agents)
  emit signals.network_graph = G
notes: Measured assortativity uses Newman assortativity for categorical attributes

modules.name: MarketingExposure
modules.description: Computes adstocked marketing exposure per agent, with segment-targeting bias and noise.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each agent i:
  seg_bias = 1.0
  if agent.segment == 'early':
    seg_bias = marketing.targeting_bias_to_early_adopters
  exposure_raw = marketing.base_reach * marketing.spend_scale * MarketingCampaign.daily_spend_total[day] * seg_bias / population_size
  noise = normal(0, marketing.noise_std)
  exposure = max(0, exposure_raw + noise)
  # adstock
  agent.marketing_memory = (1 - marketing.decay_rate) * agent.marketing_memory + exposure
compute signals.mean_exposure = mean_i(agent.marketing_memory)
notes: Adstock is a simple geometric decay
Exposure scaled per capita to stabilize across population sizes

modules.name: OpinionDynamics
modules.description: Updates agents' opinions via social influence (Friedkin-Johnsen style), self-bias, confirmation bias, and noise.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each agent i:
  neigh = neighbors(i)
  if |neigh| > 0:
    weights = [1.0 + (opinion.post_adoption_influence_boost - 1.0) * adopted(j) for j in neigh]
    o_neigh = sum_j(weights_j * opinion(j)) / sum_j(weights_j)
  else:
    o_neigh = opinion(i)
  o_self = opinion(i)
  # marketing interpreted as external signal mapped to [0,1]
  o_mkt = clamp(agent.marketing_memory / (agent.marketing_memory + 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)
  w_social = opinion.social_influence_weight
  w_self = opinion.self_bias_weight
  w_ext = max(0.0, 1.0 - w_social - w_self)
  o_raw = w_social * o_neigh + w_self * o_self + w_ext * o_mkt
  # confirmation bias: pull toward prior if change is large
  delta = o_raw - o_self
  adj = delta * (1.0 - opinion.confirmation_bias_strength * abs(delta))
  noise = normal(0, opinion.noise_std)
  opinion(i) = clamp(o_self + adj + noise, 0.0, 1.0)
notes: Weights normalized to sum to 1 with external signal taking residual weight

modules.name: AdoptionDecision
modules.description: Computes adoption and disadoption events using thresholds and utility from social, marketing, and price factors.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_events = []
for each agent i:
  # effective price after incentive
  eff_price = max(0.0, adoption.price - signals.price_adjustment_per_segment[agent.segment])
  # utilities normalized to [0,1]
  u_social = agent.opinion
  u_marketing = clamp(agent.marketing_memory / (agent.marketing_memory + 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)
  u_price = clamp(1.0 - agent.price_sensitivity * eff_price / (eff_price + 50.0), 0.0, 1.0)
  # combined propensity
  propensity = adoption.utility_social_weight * u_social + adoption.utility_marketing_weight * u_marketing + (1.0 - adoption.utility_social_weight - adoption.utility_marketing_weight) * u_price
  # decision
  if not agent.adopted and propensity >= agent.threshold:
    agent.adopted = true
    agent.days_since_adoption = 0
    adoption_events.append(i)
  elif agent.adopted:
    agent.days_since_adoption += 1
    if rand() < adoption.disadoption_rate:
      agent.adopted = false
      agent.days_since_adoption = 0
emit signals.adoption_events = adoption_events
notes: Disadoption is rare but allows churn

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily and cumulative adoption metrics and optional smoothing.

update_rule.pseudocode:
daily_new = length(signals.adoption_events)
if aggregator.smoothing_window > 1:
  daily_new_smoothed = moving_average(daily_new, window=aggregator.smoothing_window)
else:
  daily_new_smoothed = daily_new
cum_rate = mean_i(agent.adopted == true)
emit observable.daily_new_adoptions_count = daily_new_smoothed
emit observable.cumulative_adoption_rate = cum_rate

procedure: Sample segments for each agent using init.segment_prob_*
Assign price_sensitivity per agent ~ Lognormal with mean=adoption.price_sensitivity and sd=0.2
Randomly mark a fraction init.initial_adoption_rate of agents as adopted; set days_since_adoption=0
Run SocialNetworkBuilder at t=0 to assign neighbors

algorithms.network_generation: Watts–Strogatz small-world with assortativity MCMC edge swaps and triadic closure.
algorithms.opinion_update: Friedkin–Johnsen style convex combination with confirmation bias nonlinearity and Gaussian noise.
algorithms.marketing_adstock: Geometric adstock with daily decay; exposure scaled per capita.
algorithms.adoption_decision: Threshold crossing of combined utility from social, marketing, and price with optional churn.
algorithms.policy_schedule: Time-bounded step function outputting per-segment price adjustments.
